description: Use when someone asks how much it would cost to have something made, printed, machined or commissioned: a ballpark price range from The Spool List rate cards (hourly rate by discipline, complexity, materials, setup, quantity). Indicative, not a quote: makers set their own prices. Pair with create_job_request_link to get real quotes.
